card.name: Just before the word infrared
card.fires_on: Small linking words, hyphens or units right before where 'infrared' is expected, in physics, astronomy and optics text about light wavelengths.

modes.label: Linking word after a light type
modes.description: 'and', 'at' or 'in' after visible or red light, where infrared comes next.
modes.example: improves the collection of the reflected red<< and>> infrared light used for the oximeter sensor

modes.label: Wavelength range joiner
modes.description: 'to' or a space after a micrometre or nanometre value in a spectral range.
modes.example: the most representative values in the wavelength range of 0.200 μm<< to>> 5 cm were determined

modes.label: Inside near-infrared
modes.description: The hyphen piece in 'near-infrared' just before 'frared'.
modes.example: visible and near<<-in>>frared observations, confirmed it was a B
